customers.evidence: uniquely enable us to meet the evolving needs of a changing health care environment

community.evidence: helping make the health system work better for everyone

innovation.evidence: We are committed to introducing innovative approaches, products and services that can improve personal health

result.analyst_notes: Corporate, mostly factual tone, with aspirational framing in the mission ('a leader worldwide'). Uses first-person 'we' only in the commitment paragraph; otherwise third-person 'UnitedHealth Group'. Innovation is the most explicit commitment, hedged by 'can improve'. Much of the page is scale statistics (130 countries, 1 trillion transactions, 285,000 people), which are business description. Employees appear only as headcount.
